digest.component_or_area: repository-wide vocabulary policy and migration guard
propositions: Residual live prose using 'Success Criteria' terminology exists in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl and must be migrated to 'Acceptance Criteria' wording.

A repository-wide guard script must enforce case-insensitive phrase matching with count-pinned allowlist entries for deliberate permanent carve-outs, four semantic exceptions, and frozen test fixtures.
The Makefile lint target must integrate the guard so that live-source injections of deprecated vocabulary fail the lint check deterministically.

Scoped bare-token matching (SC/SCs) applies only to src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md; bare tokens outside these paths are excluded by design.

Exactly fourteen documented allowlist entries capture one match each in permanent T2 experiment language, definition-of-done carve-outs, migration scripts, behavioral probes, and historical Jira fixtures; any count drift or malformed entry causes guard failure.

The four O-RAN-SC references and minified vendor bundle must remain byte-identical and outside the bare-token rule; all excluded paths and frozen records must be validated to pass without allowlist entries.
